findings: `learner.overview.text` gives an ambiguous account: “One account proposes a link from ‘split/open’ to ‘half’” does not say what the graph depicts or how its parts work, and then treats the bronze-form 八-and-牛 analysis as straightforward. Replace it with a concise explanation that 半 means “half” and that one reported bronze analysis reads 八 as division and 牛 as the ox being divided; keep the proposed split-to-half development qualified as undated. Cite the construction and current meaning.
